mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope scope JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = scope.organization_unit_id WHERE organization.organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND organization.active = TRUE )

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seal.retention_policy_version version JOIN seal.retention_policy policy ON policy.retention_policy_id = version.retention_policy_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = policy.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE version.retention_policy_version_id = #{retentionPolicyVersionId} AND version.workflow_status = 'APPROVED' AND policy.policy_status = 'ACTIVE' AND policy.current_approved_version_id = version.retention_policy_version_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.processing_activity (processing_activity_id, activity_code, activity_name, owner_organization_unit_id, activity_status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{processingActivityId}, #{activityCode}, #{activityName}, #{ownerOrganizationUnitId}, 'ACTIVE', #{actorId}, #{actorId})

INSERT INTO seal.processing_activity_version (processing_activity_version_id, processing_activity_id, version_number, workflow_status, processing_purpose, legal_basis_type, legal_basis_detail, retention_policy_version_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{processingActivityVersionId}, #{processingActivityId}, #{versionNumber}, 'DRAFT', #{processingPurpose}, #{legalBasisType}, #{legalBasisDetail}, #{retentionPolicyVersionId}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})

INSERT INTO seal.processing_data_item (processing_data_item_id, processing_activity_version_id, item_order, item_name, necessity_reason, required, data_category) VALUES
(#{item.processingDataItemId}, #{item.processingActivityVersionId}, #{item.itemOrder}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.necessityReason}, #{item.required}, 'GENERAL')
mapper.select: SELECT version.processing_activity_version_id, version.processing_activity_id, version.version_number, version.workflow_status, version.processing_purpose, version.legal_basis_type, version.legal_basis_detail, version.retention_policy_version_id, version.created_by, version.review_requested_by, version.approved_by, version.rejection_comment, version.version_no FROM seal.processing_activity_version version JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = version.processing_activity_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE version.processing_activity_id = #{processingActivityId} AND version.processing_activity_version_id = #{processingActivityVersionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT item_name, necessity_reason, required FROM seal.processing_data_item WHERE processing_activity_version_id = #{processingActivityVersionId} ORDER BY item_order
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.processing_activity_version SET workflow_status = #{version.workflowStatus}, review_requested_by = #{version.reviewRequestedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, review_requested_at = CASE WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'REVIEW_REQUESTED' THEN #{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'DRAFT' THEN NULL ELSE review_requested_at END, approved_by = #{version.approvedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{version.workflowStatus} = 'APPROVED' THEN CAST(#{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ELSE NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ END, rejection_comment = #{version.rejectionComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{occurredAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE processing_activity_version_id = #{version.processingActivityVersionId} AND version_no = #{version.versionNo}

UPDATE seal.processing_activity SET current_approved_version_id = #{approvedVersionId}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE processing_activity_id = #{processingActivityId}
mapper.sql: SELECT activity.processing_activity_id AS activity_id, version.processing_activity_version_id AS version_id, activity.owner_organization_unit_id AS owner_organization_id, activity.activity_name, version.processing_purpose, version.legal_basis_type, version.retention_policy_version_id, (CASE retention_version.start_event WHEN 'CONSENT_SUBMITTED_AT' THEN '동의 제출 후 ' WHEN 'REQUEST_COMPLETED_AT' THEN '업무 요청 완료 후 ' WHEN 'PROGRAM_END_AT' THEN '프로그램 종료 후 ' ELSE '처리 목적 달성 후 ' END || retention_version.period_value || CASE retention_version.period_unit WHEN 'DAY' THEN '일' WHEN 'MONTH' THEN '개월' ELSE '년' END) AS retention_display_text FROM seal.processing_activity activity JOIN seal.processing_activity_version version ON version.processing_activity_version_id = activity.current_approved_version_id JOIN seal.retention_policy_version retention_version ON retention_version.retention_policy_version_id = version.retention_policy_version_id JOIN seal.retention_policy retention_policy ON retention_policy.retention_policy_id = retention_version.retention_policy_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE activity.activity_status = 'ACTIVE' AND version.workflow_status = 'APPROVED' AND version.legal_basis_type = 'CONSENT' AND retention_policy.policy_status = 'ACTIVE' AND retention_policy.current_approved_version_id = retention_version.retention_policy_version_id AND retention_version.workflow_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT activity.processing_activity_id AS activity_id, version.processing_activity_version_id AS version_id, activity.owner_organization_unit_id AS owner_organization_id, activity.activity_name, version.processing_purpose, version.legal_basis_type, version.retention_policy_version_id, (CASE retention_version.start_event WHEN 'CONSENT_SUBMITTED_AT' THEN '동의 제출 후 ' WHEN 'REQUEST_COMPLETED_AT' THEN '업무 요청 완료 후 ' WHEN 'PROGRAM_END_AT' THEN '프로그램 종료 후 ' ELSE '처리 목적 달성 후 ' END || retention_version.period_value || CASE retention_version.period_unit WHEN 'DAY' THEN '일' WHEN 'MONTH' THEN '개월' ELSE '년' END) AS retention_display_text FROM seal.processing_activity_version version JOIN seal.processing_activity activity ON activity.processing_activity_id = version.processing_activity_id JOIN seal.retention_policy_version retention_version ON retention_version.retention_policy_version_id = version.retention_policy_version_id JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = activity.owner_organization_unit_id WHERE version.processing_activity_version_id = #{processingActivityVersionId}

SELECT processing_data_item_id, item_order, item_name, required FROM seal.processing_data_item WHERE processing_activity_version_id = #{processingActivityVersionId} AND data_category = 'GENERAL' ORDER BY item_order
